en.description:
Fashion Factory is a price-comparison app for fashion, shoes, bags, perfume, watches and tech.

—— Where it stands today ——

Live store prices are not connected yet. Until our price feed is live, the app shows no products and no prices, and says so on every screen. It never shows sample or made-up prices in their place.

—— What it will do once prices are connected ——

COMPARE
A table of the stores carrying a product, side by side.

SAVE
Save products to one list on your device, with an optional price threshold that highlights an item when its price falls below it. There are no push notifications.

BROWSE AND DEALS
Browse six categories, or sort what is on sale by its discount.

—— No account needed ——

There is no sign-up and no login. Your saved list stays on your device.

en.release_notes:
Fashion Factory 2.2.

• Removed the bundled sample catalog: the app no longer shows made-up products or prices. Live store prices are not connected yet, and every screen says so
• Removed the generated price-history chart and the "Lowest yet" label
• Removed star ratings, review counts and the Trending, New and Premium filters, which had no real source
• Removed the Back in Stock, Flash Sales, Coupon Codes and Price Drop notification switches; the app has no notifications

Feedback is welcome at contact@americangroup.ai.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Fashion Factory is a price-comparison app for fashion, shoes, bags, perfume, watches and tech.

Intended audience:
Shoppers who want to compare store prices for fashion, shoes, bags, perfume, watches and tech.

Current state: no live price feed is connected in this build, so the app shows no products and no prices. Home, Browse, Deals and Saved say "Prices are unavailable" and explain why; the header search is disabled with the hint "Search unavailable until prices are connected", and the Add-a-product action is hidden because there is no catalog to match a link against. Profile (where prices come from, affiliate links and privacy) works fully. The app never shows sample or made-up prices.

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. The five tabs are reachable from the first screen after launch. While no price feed is connected there are no products, so the Product, Compare and Add-a-product screens cannot be reached.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
None in this build. No price feed is connected, so the app makes no network requests. Once a price feed is connected, the app will fetch the catalog over HTTPS from our pricing service, and Shop buttons will open the retailer's page in the system browser.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.

1. WHAT IT DOES
Fashion Factory answers one question: which store has this product cheapest right now? It has no price history.
Screens it contains: Home, Browse, Deals, Saved (saved list and price-threshold alerts, on device), Profile, Product, Compare and Add a product. In the current build no live price feed is connected, so the catalog screens show an honest "Prices are unavailable" state.

2. INTENDED USER
Shoppers comparing store prices on fashion, shoes, bags, perfume, watches and tech, who want to save products with a price threshold on their device.

  - Across all 43 apps the median pairwise similarity is 16%, and
    no pair exceeds 85%

Both numbers exclude the ~60 widgets every Flutter app uses — Column, Text,
Padding and so on. Including them makes any two Flutter apps look 97% alike,
which is a property of the framework rather than of these apps.

The store copy is distinct on the same basis: no two of the 43 share more
than 22% of their description vocabulary.
